name: Alertmanager
description: Prometheus Alertmanager reads over its v2 HTTP API: cluster status and version, currently firing and suppressed alerts, alert groups, active silences and configured receivers. Read-only; no silence create/delete or config reload is wired here. Alertmanager ships unauthenticated by default (base_url is the only credential); put it behind a reverse proxy for exposure beyond a trusted LAN.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Get Alertmanager's cluster status, uptime and version

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: List the alerts Alertmanager currently holds, with their status, labels, annotations and active window

tools.name: list_alert_groups
tools.description: List alerts grouped by their receiver and grouping labels

tools.name: list_silences
tools.description: List active and expired silences, with their matchers, time window and creator

tools.name: list_receivers
tools.description: List the notification receivers configured in Alertmanager

needs_review: AUTH IS none BY DESIGN: Alertmanager ships with no authentication on its API by default, so base_url is the only credential and auth.type is 'none'. An internet-exposed instance must sit behind a reverse proxy; that is a deployment concern, not a spec one.
READ-ONLY: all five tools are GET, write:false. Alertmanager's mutating surface (silence create/expire, config reload) is not modelled here.
status deliberately does NOT pick config.original: that field is the full loaded YAML including SMTP/webhook receiver settings, which is sensitive and far larger than the status tools need.
list_alerts, list_alert_groups and list_silences return an empty array with a 200 on a fresh instance with no rules loaded; that is a valid live proof of routing and envelope shape, not a failure.
LIVE-PROOF CONTRACT: every tool takes no input, so every _probe is {}. Proven against docker prom/alertmanager:v0.27.0, then destroyed.
